name: harness-apis-catalog
goal: Selected-revision APIs catalog lists project endpoints, and page APIs tabs show source-proven direct and transitive usage with correct contracts and scoped links

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Selected project and revision APIs, source-derived direct/transitive page usage, contracts, consumer links, responsive and historical empty states are specified and covered.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Shared catalog/category, page tab, HTTP source resolution and registry-backed CLI API reads implemented; live CLI reads 14 endpoints without restarting the shared server.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: 112 root/source/ownership/import cases, 23 local/hosted CLI cases, 3 viewport flows and 9 API route preview cases pass in their recorded scopes. Full repository verification remains pending baseline failures.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
